description: Defines a Flutter widget for an interactive, animated Tic Tac Toe board tile with visual feedback and highlighting features.

classes.name: BoardTile
classes.description: A public widget representing a single cell in the Tic Tac Toe game, capable of showing X or O, with animations and highlighting.

classes.name: _BoardTileState
classes.description: State class managing animations and interactions for BoardTile.

methods.name: createState
methods.description: Creates the mutable state for the BoardTile widget.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes animation controllers; sets up scale animation.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of animation controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _handleTapDown
methods.description: Handles tap down event; triggers scale down animation.

methods.name: _handleTapCancel
methods.description: Handles tap cancel event; reverses scale animation.

methods.name: _handleTapUp
methods.description: Handles tap up event; reverses scale animation.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree, including gesture detection, scaling, decoration, and text display.
